evidence.claim: The company reports technical specifications for its Model GJ-0417 Flameproof Methane Gas Detector, which utilizes a semiconductor sensor operating via diffusion to detect methane with a response time of 15 seconds and an alarm threshold of 10% LEL, according to its product specifications listed on IndiaMART.

The company reports a Toxic Gas Detection System featuring a backlit digital LCD display with a measuring range spanning 0–1000 ppm to monitor hazardous industrial and commercial gases, according to product documentation sourced via Justdial.

Sensor Technology & Detection Range.assessed_on: The evaluation rests on the company's verified self-reported capability to manufacture industrial fixed and portable single-gas detectors under its Gas Janitor brand that cover basic semiconductor configurations for targets such as LPG, methane, and toxic gases up to 1000 ppm. Based on primary research, the company has not disclosed third-party performance verifications or data regarding advanced infrared (IR) or catalytic sensor varieties.

evidence.claim: The company reports offering permanently fixed weatherproof and flameproof industrial and commercial gas leak detectors, such as the GJ-0517, GJ-0317, and the PESO-approved GJ-0417 and GJ-0617 models, which support gases including LPG, PNG, Ammonia, and Hydrogen, as published on its official Gas Janitor Brand Portal.

The company reports supplying microprocessor-based conventional type gas leakage control panels with 2 zones and 16x2 LCD line displays, as detailed in its product technical specifications listed on Justdial.
